uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7509.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Spawning Pit abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
3899-6972-7509.notes: If Gleeful Arsonist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

978-2420-4738.description:
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.
Repeat.

2137-3177-7857.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to cast the instant or sorcery
2137-3177-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control two lands that enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce mana.
2137-3177-7857.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand for which legal target(s) exist, if applicable.
2137-3177-7857.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control from the battlefield to your hand, copying the instant or sorcery spell.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer triggers, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout
Repeat steps 3 and 4 one additional time.
Activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Repeat from step 2.

67-1676-5670-6917-7818.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
67-1676-5670-6917-7818.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it, Liliana the Faultless and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Citizens enter, Liliana the Faultless triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
67-1676-5670-6917-7818.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.

5086-5183-5231-6996-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
5086-5183-5231-6996-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-5359-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk.
When Threefold Thunderhulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters, it triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Golem artifact creature tokens equal to its power.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

643-1636-7170.notablePrerequisites:
Maskwood Nexus does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
643-1636-7170.description:
Animate Maskwood with Living Brain.
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token.
When the Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

141-3967-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3967-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-3967-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

11-4377-6555-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-4377-6555-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Walk the Aeons.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Walk the Aeons spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Walk the Aeons spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Walk the Aeons and returning the original Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Walk the Aeons from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

1492-2866-4986-6797.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2866-4986-6797.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

997-5220-6538-6900.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

856-3698-5477-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar, Grinding Station and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
When the Plant enters the battlefield as a Food due to Ygra, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

1170-2187-2196-2701.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1170-2187-2196-2701.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Frantic Search from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat.

3528-3976-5014.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3528-3976-5014.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding Rise of the Eldrazi.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{R}{B}, noting Rise of the Eldrazi and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the 3/3 creature that has Rise of the Eldrazi noted.
The creature triggers, casting a copy of Rise of the Eldrazi without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Rise of the Eldrazi copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.
3528-3976-5014.notes: The discard outlet is provided as a method of getting Rise of the Eldrazi into your graveyard, as it does not go to the graveyard after resolution. You can substitute any other method for this, including using mill or other techniques.

1645-1765-3000-4050.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, targeting any creature you control.
When Crown of Flames enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Spirit and Squirrel, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1494-3314-4264.notablePrerequisites: Chulane does not have summoning sickness.
1494-3314-4264.description:
Cast Altered Ego by paying {7}{G}{U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a land onto the battlefield from your hand.
Resolve Altered Ego, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Sage of Hours with five +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Altered Ego by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning Altered Ego to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

1025-1581-1948.notablePrerequisites: Zur does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1025-1581-1948.description:
Declare Zur as an attacker.
Zur triggers, causing you to search your library for Stasis and put it onto the battlefield.
During the end step prior to your turn, activate Rishadan Pawnshop by paying {2} and tapping it, shuffling Stasis into your library from the battlefield.
Repeat.

2177-3096-3819.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
2177-3096-3819.description:
Cast Selective Memory by paying {3}{U}, exiling all nonland cards from your library.
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Cultivator Colossus enters the battlefield, causing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and draw a card.
Repeat the process in step 3 until you draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game.

253-2935-4695.description:
Activate Ethereal Champion by paying 1 life, preventing the next one damage that will be dealt to Ethereal Champion this turn.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Soul Conduit by paying {6} and tapping it, exchanging your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this on each of your turns.

813-1987-2427-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
